title: Problems Around Polynomials — Conjecture 5
exact_target: Can preservation of real roots separated by at least one, for all polynomials of bounded degree, be tested on one falling-factorial polynomial?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2200009 (AMR-021-0009). CC BY 4.0.

Boris Shapiro, Problems Around Polynomials -- The Good, The Bad and The Ugly, Arnold Mathematical Journal 1 (2015), pp.91--104, Conjecture 5 and its complete preceding definitions. Original question and full discussion.
Petter Brändén, Ilia Krasikov and Boris Shapiro, Elements of Pólya--Schur theory in finite difference setting (2013), Section 1 mesh definition and Section 4, Conjectures 2 and 3.
